legend.0: Localized change in one small area with straightforward implementation.
legend.1: Small change spanning a few related units with limited coordination.
legend.2: Moderate change across multiple units requiring deliberate integration.
legend.3: Broad change across subsystems requiring substantial coordination and validation.
legend.4: System-wide change with complex cross-cutting implementation and coordination.

legend.0: Negligible chance of harmful delivery or operational consequences.
legend.1: Low chance of limited, readily recoverable delivery or operational consequences.
legend.2: Moderate chance of contained delivery or operational consequences requiring mitigation.
legend.3: High chance of significant delivery or operational consequences requiring active safeguards.
legend.4: Critical chance or severity of delivery or operational consequences requiring exceptional safeguards.

legend.0: No meaningful architectural, interface, or contract change.
legend.1: Localized architectural change with no broad interface or contract implications.
legend.2: Change affecting several related components or a bounded contract.
legend.3: Cross-subsystem architectural change affecting important interfaces or contracts.
legend.4: Foundational change that reshapes system boundaries, interfaces, or contracts.
